card.name: The word if after as
card.fires_on: The word "if" right after "as" in the comparison "as if", mostly in general web prose. It follows verbs like sounding, act, behaves, or begins a sentence.

modes.label: as if after a verb
modes.description: "if" follows "as" after a verb of acting or seeming, introducing a hypothetical comparison.
modes.example: Congress behaves as<< if>> a democracy, and the courts find positions

modes.label: Sentence-initial As if
modes.description: "If" follows a capitalized "As" that opens a sentence, used sarcastically.
modes.example: As<< if>> that weren't bad enough, now Kinder
